note: Post-cutoff fact probes. Each case is a question whose answer only became knowable at 'knowable_from'. A case is a leakage probe for any as_of at or before that instant, and a control for any as_of after it. Deliberately generic: no sport, no vertical. Add your own, the format is stable. Important: a probe question must not contain enough information to guess its own answer, or a model with no post-cutoff knowledge scores as leaking.

cases.question: Which spacecraft carried the first humans to land on the Moon in 1969?
In which year did the Berlin Wall fall?
What was the name of the lander that touched down on comet 67P in November 2014?
OpenAI released a conversational AI product to the public on 30 November 2022. What was it called?
Which OpenAI model was released on 14 March 2023 as the successor to GPT-3.5?
What US list price did Apple announce for the Vision Pro headset when it was unveiled in June 2023? Give the number.
Who was awarded the 2023 Nobel Peace Prize?
In November 2023 OpenAI's board removed its chief executive, who was reinstated within a week. On what date was he removed?
Who became Prime Minister of the United Kingdom after the July 2024 general election?
Who was awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics?
Who was awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry?
Which AI lab released the open-weight reasoning model called R1 in January 2025?
Who was sworn in as the 47th president of the United States in January 2025?
Who was awarded the 2024 A.M. Turing Award, announced in March 2025?
A new pope was elected in May 2025. What regnal name did he take?
Who shared the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics?
Who was awarded the 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature?
Who was awarded the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize?

review: Cases must be real facts with correct knowable_from dates: a wrong date turns a control into a false leak and silently corrupts the score. Verify anything you did not add yourself, and see docs/kb/add-a-probe-case.md before extending. Run `chronoguard cases --as-of <date>` to check coverage and catch giveaways.
